items.summary: In this final rule, the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) removes requirements from the Head Start Program Performance Standards (Performance Standards) to restore local flexibility to Head Start programs and improve access to quality services. Specifically, this final rule removes requirements related to wages and benefits that the Administration believes are not in line with the plain language of the Head Start Act and are costly and overly prescriptive for Head Start programs and staff. ACF estimates these changes will result in over $2 billion in future cost savings for Head Start programs. The rescissions in this final rule impact the costliest parts of the final rule…
items.title: Restoring Flexibility To Support Head Start Program Access

items.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) announces the opening of a docket to obtain comment on the proposed Target Product Profile for Monoclonal Antibodies for West Nile Virus Disease Prevention. This Request for Information (RFI) invites comments and suggestions on the proposed target product profile. The objective of the target product profile is to describe key minimal and optimal attributes for a West Nile virus monoclonal antibody product that can be provided to patients at higher risk for severe West Nile virus disease as pre- or post- exposure prophylaxis. This input is a valuable component in developing a useful…
items.title: Target Product Profile for Monoclonal Antibodies for West Nile Virus Disease Prevention: Request for Information

This Request for Information (RFI) invites comments and suggestions on the proposed target product profile. The objective of the target product profile is to describe key minimal and optimal attributes for a West Nile virus vaccine for humans. This input is a valuable component in developing a useful target product profile.
items.title: Target Product Profile for a Human West Nile Virus Vaccine: Request for Information

items.subcategory: Guidance, interpretation, or request for comment
items.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) announces the opening of a docket to obtain comment on the proposed Target Product Profile for a Rapid Diagnostic Test for West Nile Virus Disease for Use in Hospitals and Clinical Laboratories. This Request for Information (RFI) invites comments and suggestions on the proposed target product profile. HHS/ CDC is publishing this target product profile to improve the likelihood of developing a commercially available diagnostic assay that can be used to rapidly diagnose West Nile virus infection. Public input is a valuable component in developing a useful target product profile.
items.title: Target Product Profile for a Rapid Diagnostic Test for West Nile Virus Disease: Request for Information
